name: Pack of 2 | O’Mayln Vitamin C Gel Face Mask 30ml | Brightening & Hydrating Facial
description:
Revitalize your skin with the O’Mayln Vitamin C Gel Face Mask (30ml, Pack of 2) — a refreshing skincare treatment that brightens, hydrates, and soothes your complexion. Enriched with Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid, and Aloe Vera, this gentle gel mask helps even out skin tone, reduce dark spots, and deeply moisturize for a smooth, radiant glow.
Its lightweight gel texture feels cool and soothing on the skin, making it ideal for all skin types — even sensitive ones. Regular use helps restore your skin’s natural brightness, leaving it soft, supple, and glowing.
Key Features: Brightens and evens out skin tone Deeply hydrates and plumps skin Soothes redness and irritation Refreshes dull, tired skin Suitable for all skin types
How to Use:① Apply the gel mask evenly to clean, dry skin.② Leave on for 15–20 minutes.③ Rinse off with lukewarm water and pat dry.④ Use 1–2 times per week for best results.
